js: 'MCP servers as a list beside the detail: the tool inventory with nothing selected (a group per source, folded, the filter), a click selects a server (its path) and shows its form and its tools, the arrows move the selection, a built-in toolset (its tools, no form), the list search (/ focuses it, a miss says so, Esc clears it), a tool switch (applies at once, put back), a dirty change on the server named notes-demo (the accent dot, the save toast, the guard asking, Ctrl+S saving, the value read back, then put back), the new-server form, and the narrow window. It SAVES and switches tools: run it on a dev copy with a stdio server named notes-demo (command python3, args scripts/mock-mcp.py), never on production. Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/mcp-split.json --dsf 1.25 --token-file <dir>.token --base http://<addr> --podman-guard <prefix>'
